title.en: Lease Agreements for Retail Premises Regulations 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Lease Agreements for Retail Premises Regulations 2023 and come into operation on 1 February 2024.

heading.en: Prescribed period for submission of declaration of permitted deviation

text.en:
2.—(1) For the purposes of section 6(3)(a) of the Act, the prescribed period for submission of a declaration of permitted deviation is 14 days after the date the lease agreement is signed by the landlord and the tenant.
(2) For the purposes of sections 23(4)(a) and 24(4)(a) of the Act, the prescribed period for submission of a declaration of permitted deviation is 14 days after the date the settlement agreement is signed by the parties.

heading.en: Prescribed period for filing complaint of non‑compliance

text.en:
3. For the purposes of section 9(2)(a) of the Act, the complaint of non‑compliance must be filed with an authorised dispute resolution body within 14 days after —
(a)for an alleged non‑compliance with a leasing principle under section 2(4)(a) or (b) of the Act — the date the lease agreement is signed by the landlord and the tenant; and
(b)for an alleged non‑compliance with a leasing principle under section 2(4)(c) or (d) of the Act — the date of the alleged non‑compliance with the leasing principle.
